translations.web: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?
translations.bsb: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He blindfolds its judges. If it is not He, then who is it?
translations.kjv: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where,
translations.asv: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He covereth the faces of the judges thereof: If it be not he, who then is it?
